documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, highlighting resilient performance despite geopolitical tensions, raw material inflation, and global supply-side disruptions affecting the phosphatic fertilizer industry. Quarterly revenue reached ₹532 crore with an EBITDA of ₹89 crore, supported by disciplined cost management, diversified raw material sourcing, and new complex fertilizer introductions. Management expressed confidence in achieving strong revenue growth and higher capacity utilization over the remaining quarters of FY27 as raw material availability has normalized. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY growth in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore for Q1 FY27. The company's performance was supported by progressive contributions from expanded capacities at its Meghnagar facility, including NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid.

guidance.claim: Management stated expectations to achieve around 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company projects importing around 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27, generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that fertilizer offtake accelerated across several key markets following a material improvement in monsoon activity in early July.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Management indicated that industry production declines were driven by supply-side constraints rather than underlying demand weakness, with NPK and SSP sales increasing year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: P&K production reached 15.76 lakh metric tonnes during the Rabi season peak period.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as food demand remains essential.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects fertilizer demand to remain stable despite a forecast monsoon level of around 95% of normal.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA at Meghnagar are actively contributing to operations.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that no additional capex or expansion plans have been planned beyond the completed implementation.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported EBITDA margins of approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that sulfur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 Profit After Tax grew by 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operational efficiency and cost management.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Overall EBITDA margin declined to 12.34% in FY26 from 13.54% in FY25 due to a higher proportion of trading turnover.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

margins_costs.claim: The trading segment operates at an EBITDA margin of 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects first-quarter margin pressure to stabilize later in the year as cost increases are passed on.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported capacity utilization of 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT with an additional 165,000 MT, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported Q1 fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is approximately 200,000 tons with utilization currently between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted the successful execution of a 5-for-1 stock split to subdivide equity share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the company's five key strategic pillars.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion was funded using internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Effective short-term borrowing costs range between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stood at almost Rs. 400 crore, while other receivables were between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore at the end of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz introduced disruptions and higher freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal by the end of June, causing national Kharif sowing to decline year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input markets experienced firming price trends driven by supply-side constraints, gas-linked production tightness, and increased freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the green ammonia facility tied under agreement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material translating to approximately Rs. 1,000 crore of revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
